texts.name: a stale scope in English names the member and the command
texts.expected: The lock file of dependency scope ♻️mit-bestand is out of date: Bun would refuse its frozen installation, but only after the build has waited in its queue. Changed: ../✏️s/x is a member the lock does not list. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: repo dependencies lock --scope ♻️mit-bestand

texts.name: the same scope in German
texts.expected: Die Lock-Datei des Abhängigkeits-Scopes ♻️mit-bestand ist veraltet: Bun würde ihre eingefrorene Installation verweigern, aber erst nachdem der Build in seiner Warteschlange gewartet hat. Geändert: ../✏️s/x ist ein Mitglied, das der Lock nicht führt. Lock neu erzeugen, den Diff prüfen und den Befehl erneut ausführen: repo dependencies lock --scope ♻️mit-bestand

texts.name: no language chosen offers both, English first
texts.expected:
The lock file of dependency scope . is out of date: Bun would refuse its frozen installation, but only after the build has waited in its queue. Changed: scope root declares devDependencies x 1, which the lock lacks. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: repo dependencies lock --scope .
Die Lock-Datei des Abhängigkeits-Scopes . ist veraltet: Bun würde ihre eingefrorene Installation verweigern, aber erst nachdem der Build in seiner Warteschlange gewartet hat. Geändert: Scope-Wurzel deklariert devDependencies x 1, was dem Lock fehlt. Lock neu erzeugen, den Diff prüfen und den Befehl erneut ausführen: repo dependencies lock --scope .

texts.name: every kind, the scope root label, absent values and the list limit
texts.expected: The lock file of dependency scope ✏️s is out of date: Bun would refuse its frozen installation, but only after the build has waited in its queue. Changed: ../✏️s/x is a member the lock does not list; old is listed by the lock but is no member; scope root name is r2 but the lock says r; a declares dependencies d 1, which the lock lacks; a no longer declares devDependencies e, which the lock still lists; b declares dependencies f 3, the lock says 4; and 2 more. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: repo dependencies lock --scope ✏️s

texts.name: every kind in German
texts.expected: Die Lock-Datei des Abhängigkeits-Scopes ✏️s ist veraltet: Bun würde ihre eingefrorene Installation verweigern, aber erst nachdem der Build in seiner Warteschlange gewartet hat. Geändert: ../✏️s/x ist ein Mitglied, das der Lock nicht führt; old steht im Lock, ist aber kein Mitglied; Scope-Wurzel name ist r2, der Lock sagt r; a deklariert dependencies d 1, was dem Lock fehlt; a deklariert devDependencies e nicht mehr, der Lock führt es noch; b deklariert dependencies f 3, der Lock sagt 4; und 2 weitere. Lock neu erzeugen, den Diff prüfen und den Befehl erneut ausführen: repo dependencies lock --scope ✏️s

texts.name: a refusal without a static finding says a resolved package changed
texts.expected:
Bun refused the frozen installation of dependency scope 🌎️hub: its lock file no longer matches its manifests. Static comparison: no manifest difference found, a resolved package changed. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: repo dependencies lock --scope 🌎️hub
Bun hat die eingefrorene Installation des Abhängigkeits-Scopes 🌎️hub verweigert: Die Lock-Datei passt nicht mehr zu den Manifesten. Statischer Vergleich: kein Manifest-Unterschied gefunden, ein aufgelöstes Paket hat sich geändert. Lock neu erzeugen, den Diff prüfen und den Befehl erneut ausführen: repo dependencies lock --scope 🌎️hub

texts.name: a refusal with findings lists them
texts.expected: Bun refused the frozen installation of dependency scope 🏢️semio-tech: its lock file no longer matches its manifests. Static comparison: pkgs/a no longer declares dependencies ms, which the lock still lists. Regenerate the lock, review its diff and run the command again: repo dependencies lock --scope 🏢️semio-tech

scopes.name: scopes are the root and every owner directory with a lock; members are normalized, globs and missing members skipped
an owner pattern deeper than one level is refused by name

staged.name: a staged lock names the original member behind w/<index>
a staged lock that lacks a member row is a workspace finding of that member
an in-sync staged lock has no finding
a staged lock whose package lost its last user is frozen, one that keeps a user is noise
